SCOPE NOTE: lens was ci.yml only; all line numbers verified against the file on disk (2547 lines).

1) MATRIX COUNT: the brief says "five" matrix python-version labels; ci.yml actually has SEVEN matrix declarations (`python-version: ['3.11']`) — lint L139, typecheck L180, unit-tests L208, integration api L390, websocket L508, services L617, models L733 — plus workflow env L15. 2) THE REAL TRAP IS NODE, NOT ARTIFACTS. Every Node reference in ci.yml interpolates env.NODE_VERSION, so artifact-name contracts are safe — BUT four jobs (L1181 frontend-lint, L1213 frontend-typecheck, L1250 frontend-tests, L1450 frontend-e2e) redeclare `NODE_VERSION: '20'` at job level, and GitHub job env OVERRIDES workflow env. Either change all five literals to '24' or (true SSOT per the goal) delete the four job-level lines — for L1250 delete only that line; the env block must keep NODE_OPTIONS (L1257).

3) ARTIFACT CONTRACT AUDIT RESULT: all five download-artifact steps in ci.yml (L322/324, L854/856, L1379/1381, L1976/1978, L1984/1986) use `pattern:` globs; zero use an exact `name:`.
